title: Xiaomi Huami Amazfit Bip Lite
body:
Is it possible zo integrate my new Xiaomi Huami Amazfit Bip Lite?

My setup: Libre / miaomiao / xdrip+ (adc3870-2018.09.15)

If I go to: Settings - Smart Watch Properties I found the point AmazFit Sync Service but not more to 
 integrate my Xiaomi Huami Amazfit Bip Lite.

comments.body:
Hi, yes sounds interesting to have that option, but nobody knows what this exactly can do... Btw, I am using Xdrip+ since I abandoned last week my iPhone 7 + Spike setup to explore all the amazing options that Android offers with Xdrip. Which smartwatch do you recommend me? I was thinking about a second hand Pebble classic, but I do not know if Xdrip+ allows to directly connect via Bluetooth to the Pebble. Thanks for the tips!

By the way @Fohlenpower I think the Ticwatch E is not a bad option neither if you want a smartwatch, and it only costs 120$!
It works with Amazfit Pace and Stratos watches, but not with bip.

Thanks @Klaus3d3 do you know how to install it on Amazfit devices? do you also know if the connection is direct between the Amazfit and the Miaomiao transmitter? I understood that only WearOS 2.0 smartwathces can be configured as Data Collectors

Yes i know, 'cause i made it.

See this:

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/353

The watchface needs to be installed to the watch and on phones side you must activate the service.

The Amazfit Service in this master repository is not up to date. Therefor use the latest release of my fork until i made a new pull request.
I‘d love to see the Bip integrated, would be a very nice Pebble replacement.

+1 on the BIP integration, also since BIP has an incredible battery life. 
Main difference as far as I can see: BIP is on MiFit, Stratos and Pace are on the Amazfit App.

+1 for the bip. It's the most "innocent" looking of the huami family watches, that would also be worn by a woman :)
Looking forward to a BIP watch face, together with the long battery life it will be a great tool to monitoring my BG
